text:
Happy Feet
Every [emperor penguin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emperor_penguin) attracts a [mate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mating) by singing a unique "heartsong". If the [male](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Male) penguin's heartsong matches the [female](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Female)'s song, the two penguins mate. Norma Jean, a female penguin, falls for Memphis, a male penguin and they become mates. They lay an egg, which Memphis cares for while Norma Jean leaves with the other females to [fish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fishing). While the males struggle through the harsh [winter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winter), Memphis briefly drops the egg. The resulting chick, Mumble, is unable to sing but is nevertheless enamored with Gloria, a female penguin who is regarded as the most talented of her age. One day, Mumble discovers he is able to [tap dance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tap_dance) before encountering a group of hostile [skua](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skua), with a leader who is tagged with a [yellow band](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bird_ringing), which he says is from an [alien abduction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alien_abduction). Mumble narrowly escapes the hungry birds by falling into a crevice.
title: Happy Feet

text:
Happy Feet
Now a young adult, Mumble is frequently ridiculed by the elders and their leader Noah. After escaping from a [leopard seal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leopard_seal) attack, Mumble befriends five [Adelie penguins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelie_penguin) named Ramón, Nestor, Lombardo, Rinaldo and Raul, known collectively as "the Amigos", who embrace Mumble's dance moves and assimilate him into their group. After seeing a hidden human [excavator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator) in an avalanche, they opt to ask Lovelace, a [rockhopper penguin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_rockhopper_penguin), about its origin. text:
Happy Feet
At the forbidden shore, Mumble, Lovelace, and the Amigos are attacked by two [orcas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orca), during which Lovelace is freed from the plastic rings. After escaping, they find a fishing boat and climb atop a tall iceberg. In the distance, they see several more boats, the cause of their fish scarcity. Mumble jumps into the water and exhaustingly pursues them alone, eventually washing up on a beach. He is rescued and brought to Marine World, a fictional zoo in [Miami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miami), in an exhibit with [Magellanic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magellanic_penguin) and [chinstrap](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinstrap_penguin) penguins. After a long and secluded confinement unsuccessfully attempting to communicate with humans visiting the exhibit, he is about to succumb to [madness](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insanity) when he unexpectedly reveals his dancing skills to the humans, who are all amazed. He is released back into the wild with a [tracking device](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPS_wildlife_tracking) attached to his back. He returns to his colony and challenges the will of the elders. Memphis reconciles with him just as a research team arrives, verifying Mumble's statements of "aliens" existing. The entire colony engages in dance in front of the research team, whose expedition footage prompts a worldwide debate which eventually results in a ban on all Antarctic [overfishing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overfishing), satisfying both the emperor penguins and the Amigos.
title: Happy Feet
